string-array.name: tips
string-array.item: For shared playlists to work, %1$s needs to know where your media files are stored. Add your media folders in 'Settings > General > Media Directories for Shared Playlist'.
Want to use the video player solo? Select a player, tap the %1$s logo above, then choose 'Offline Mode'.
You can always reset settings to their default states by going to 'Settings -> Advanced -> Reset to Default'
Joining the same room repeatedly? Save it as a shortcut on your device for one-tap access by clicking the small button next to 'Join Room'.
Each player has different strengths. If one doesn't work well with your video format, try another.
%1$s plays direct links and, on Android, YouTube and a few other sites. Paste the link under Add media.
If you want to minimize the room temporarily without leaving, you can go into "Picture-in-Picture" mode where the screen is a small floating screen above other apps.

Turns off the blurred surfaces everywhere and puts video back on the efficient hardware path. Use it if playback stutters, drains the battery, or you want HDR passthrough. Applies the next time you enter a room.
YouTube, SoundCloud, PeerTube, Bandcamp and media.ccc.de on Android and desktop; YouTube on iOS. Resolved on the device, nothing else installed.

Anything but audio can cause problems on displays above 60 Hz. Lower the device's refresh rate if it does.
Fast is the phone-friendly default. Low-latency helps when streaming from a live source.
For example --file-caching=5000 --network-caching=3000. Applies the next time the VLC engine starts.
Off removes the short delay a single tap has while the app waits for a second tap.
Join lands on your own server at %1$s.

The address and port the host gave you. Official servers are syncplay.pl on ports 8995 to 8999; a friend hosting from this app shares an address like 192.168.1.20:8999. Add the password only if the host set one.

Google's Media3 player, built into Android. Decodes on the device's hardware through MediaCodec. Plays MP4, MKV, WebM, HLS and DASH with the common codecs; ASS subtitles show as plain text. The stable choice for ordinary files. Built into Synkplay: nothing extra to install.

libmpv with FFmpeg, the same engine as the desktop mpv. Plays nearly every container and codec, draws styled ASS subtitles, supports chapters and precise seeking. The best fit for anime and MKV releases. Only in the full build. Built into Synkplay: nothing extra to install.

Made by Synkplay's own developer on top of FFmpeg, and tuned for Synkplay. Still experimental: playback can misbehave, so switch engines if something looks off. Built into Synkplay: nothing extra to install.
Apple's system player. Very stable and battery friendly, but narrow: MP4, MOV and HLS with the codecs iOS ships, no external subtitles, no chapters. Built into Synkplay: nothing extra to install.
VideoLAN's libVLC 4 for iOS. Plays nearly every container and codec, external subtitles, chapters, picture in picture. The stable default on iOS. Built into Synkplay: nothing extra to install.
